summary: Held the entire window. The entry ran favorably almost immediately (px crossed +10 by t=1m) and kept extending to +100-140pts by t=6-10m; the only adverse signals were normal pullbacks/giveback spikes during consolidation (e.g. t=11-18m chopping between +70 and +110) that never approached breakeven, let alone negative territory, and against-fires (HA/PROPP) were transient and got countermanded within 1-2 frames. Nothing here resembled wrong-direction behavior, so EXIT was never warranted. Next time I'd watch for giveback approaching 100% while px is compressing toward zero (not just amplitude-relative giveback while still deep in profit) as the real bail trigger.
